notes: Ulam's 10 improvements per generation, 1e6 and 1e13 reproduce; the deterministic logistic from p0 = 1e-10 gives 2.30e7 to half and 2.76e7 to 0.99, so his '10^6 to most' is 23x short while the total, 2.3-2.8e13, stays within 3x of 1e13 and is 27-76x the 3.65e11 one-day generations available. Under Mayr's gamma = 0.3 the serial total is 7.7e7; under simultaneity with Ulam's own supply of 10 per generation it is about 2.8e7. Both fit. The serial premise and gamma carry the whole gap; neither is measured in the volume. Drift loss of new improvements (fixation about 2 gamma) is outside Ulam's model and not added.
